operations.name: indexnow_submit_urls
operations.description: Tell Bing, Yandex, Seznam and Naver that these URLs are new or changed, so they crawl in hours instead of weeks. There is no API key: ownership is proven by a plain-text file at https://<host>/<key>.txt whose only content is the key itself -- commit that file to the site first (any 8-128 char hex string works as a key), then call this with the same key. HTTP 200 means accepted, 403 means the key file is missing or does not match. Max 10000 URLs per call. Only usable when a proposal listing this tool has been approved.

host.describe: Bare hostname of the site, no scheme and no path, e.g. 'pms-compare.vercel.app'

key.describe: The key already hosted at https://<host>/<key>.txt

keyLocation.describe: Full URL of the key file. Only needed when it is not at the host root, e.g. a subdirectory deploy

urlList.describe: Absolute URLs to submit. Every one must be on `host` or the whole request is rejected with 422
